eha_chhatarpur.identity_basis: The reporting association names Christian Hospital Chhatarpur on Mahoba Road, Chhatarpur 471001, matching the release name, branch address and PIN.

eha_herbertpur.identity_basis: The reporting association names Herbertpur Christian Hospital in Herbertpur, Dehradun 248142, matching the release name, locality and PIN.

eha_kachhwa.identity_basis: The reporting association names Kachhwa Christian Hospital in Kachhwa, Mirzapur 231501, matching the release name, locality and PIN.

kem_mumbai.identity_basis: The release lists the hospital at Parel, Mumbai 400012 and gives the kem.edu domain. The institution's annual statistical reports name KEM Hospital at Parel, Mumbai 400012 on that same domain.

sanjay_gandhi_memorial.identity_basis: The reporting branch explicitly identifies itself as Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital in Mangolpuri, Delhi 110083, matching the release name, locality and PIN.

rtrmh.identity_basis: Delhi Health lists Rao Tula Ram Memorial Hospital at Jaffarpur Kalan, New Delhi 110073, matching the release branch name, locality and PIN.

govt_lawley.identity_basis: The Nilgiris district identifies its Government Lawely Hospital in Coonoor, identifying the Coonoor government hospital in Table 1. The release names the branch Government Lawley Hospital and places it in Coonoor.

pattukkottai_gh.identity_basis: The government municipal hospital list explicitly names Government Hospital, Palaniyappan Street, Pattukkottai, matching the release street and town. The site appears as Pattukottai in the DMS table.

raja_mirasdar.identity_basis: Thanjavur's official district directory gives the Raja Mirasudhar name variant at the Old Bus Stand, PIN 613001, matching the named Raja Mirasdar branch and landmark in the release.

chengalpattu_medical_college.identity_basis: The release lists this row as Chengalpattu Government Hospital and identifies its official website as cmccpt.ac.in. That exact domain publishes the Government Chengalpattu Medical College and Hospital name and PIN 603001.
